features.description: No of flows that has a command in ftp session.

features.description: No. of connections that contain the same service (14) and source address (1) in 100 connections according to the last time (26).

features.description: No. of connections that contain the same service (14) and destination address (3) in 100 connections according to the last time (26).

features.name: ct_src_ ltm

features.description: No of connections of the same source address (1) and the destination port (4) in 100 connections according to the last time (26).
